title: Core Glossary: Ruff
description: Core Glossary: Ruff: the working vocabulary of Ruff: 10 terms with plain definitions, runnable as a demo. Ruff: Developer tool: Ruff. Made by Astral, first released 2022. Runs on Cross-platform; licensed as MIT.
definition: Core Glossary: Ruff — the working vocabulary of Ruff: 10 terms with plain definitions, runnable as a demo..
key_points: Compiler: Translates source code into machine code before the program runs.
Interpreter: Runs source code directly, line by line, without a separate build step.
Debugger: Steps through running code, inspects variables, and finds faults.
Linter: Checks code for style errors and likely bugs without running it.
Build: The process turning source files into a runnable program or package.
Dependency: An external library a project needs in order to build or run.
Repository: Version-controlled project history hosted locally or on a service.
CI: Continuous integration: automated builds and tests on every change.
API: The defined interface other programs use to talk to a tool or library.
SDK: Software development kit: libraries, docs and tools for one platform.
